rules.description: Strip known inflectional verbal suffix from segment_host when is_verbal=True
rules.condition: is_verbal=True AND segment_host ends with known suffix AND remaining consonants >= 2

rules.description: Strip bare waw (واو الجماعة) when clitic consumed the full وا
rules.condition: is_verbal=True AND host ends with solo و AND consonants before >= 2

rules.description: Detect Form II-X via p2_augmented.detector.detect_augmented on bare stem
rules.output_classification: DERIVATIONAL_EXTENSION for pattern affixes; RADICAL for core consonants
rules.note: Two-pass: first on suffix-stripped stem; fallback force-strips suffix when path is AMBIGUOUS

rules.description: Strip imperfect verb prefix (يَ/تَ/نَ/أَ) when verb evidence present
rules.condition: is_verbal=True AND stem starts with known prefix pair AND 3rd char not long vowel AND remaining consonants >= 2
prohibitions: NO strip when 3rd char is و/ا/ي (long vowel — would strip from nominal like نَوْم)

rules.description: Analyze bare stem for trilateral root via p3_candidate.root_rules
rules.condition: After suffix and prefix stripped; no augmented form detected
rules.note: Weak consonants in root → DEFER not ACCEPT

rules.description: Detect weak root identity in augmented root output
Preserve BLOCK from pre_root — never reopen closed boundary
prohibitions: NO root opened after JAMID_AALAM, OPERATOR, MABNI boundaries
